data.name: Shardul
data.long_meaning: A name of Lord Shiva, derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shard' (mountain) and 'Dhul' (purifier). It represents strength, power, and purification.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the divine presence of Lord Shiva, the supreme deity in Hinduism, who is believed to bestow strength, power, and purification.
